posts.title: Bru: Send and read SMS from the browser
posts.description: Short version: Bru is an Android app and web client that lets you read and send SMS messages from your browser, via your phone. It is currently available from the IzzyOnDroid app repository, but hopefully soon on F-Droid, and possibly Google Play.
